searchText: No, not shortly after the merge. We've been putting the light client refactor off in order to ship the merge. It will be implemented, but probably only after the merge I’ve started a discussion about adding ability of running nodes behind TOR in <#646778960830660623> channel. No specific proposals yet though. Harsh! Hope you’re ok. Why “FATCA prevents leaving usg” though? Fatca should not prevent relinquishing citizenship. At the least, you need second citizenship. Hypothetically you can become stateless, but things are *incredibly* complicated to do that. Yep, 2nd citizenship sounds like a plan. It is not cheap. Even if you go the residency route, you have to find another country that will accept you, which usually means local employment, and then you need to go through whatever residency program they have. If you are self employed/digital nomad, things become much more expensive. We need onchain citizenship 😄 The Sango project of the CAR seems promising (If anyone wanted to live there). I assume UAE aka Dubai will have something eventually. It makes it super expensive to do so Also just got eth.link via auction. Should it be used for public boost endpoint url?
